title: The Pre-Sale That Worked and the Payment Bas van Abel Feared to Send
conflicts: Pre-order pace: 2013 sources (Waag, Fairphone blog, TechCrunch, The Register) show 5,000 reached in about three weeks; NPR (2014) and Tech.eu (2015) say 10,000 in three weeks. Story uses the contemporary 5,000. Team size: eight (Waag, 2013) vs 'five people' (van Abel to The Big Issue, later); story uses eight. Exact day of the milestone differs by a day between reports; story says 'the first days of June'.
notes: The €1.5 million payment hesitation ('I couldn't push the damn button on my laptop') rests on van Abel's own 2015 Tech.eu interview and is attributed. Funding 'bootstrapped' means customer pre-payments funded the first run, not investors. Van Abel's own remarks about paying bribes in Congo were left out as outside the episode.
